title: workspace.personal.created
description: A personal workspace was auto-created for a user (first-login bootstrap). Carries the account's identity fields so a consumer that must materialise a local shadow row for user_id can do it HONESTLY — with the id alone a guest mirrors as is_anonymous=false, auth_type="email" (the model defaults), which is wrong until the account's first authenticated request to that service repairs it. Privileges are deliberately absent: an event is not a token.
